name: Smash Your Bros
tagline: A bromance platform fighter: knock your bros off the stage.
goal: Climb the Classic ladder against CPU bros: 8 rounds, then the host’s camera. Lose a round and the run ends; beat the host and a harder loop begins.
scoring: Each round won: 1,000, +250 per stock left, +10 per second under 2:00. Beating Max Ratings +2,000, The Big BROadcast +3,000. Each KO 100 (stagehands 25). Loop 2 doubles all of it, loop 3 triples it, and so on.

modifiers.name: Moon Bros
modifiers.text: Moon gravity: floaty jumps, endless recoveries, KOs off the top.

modifiers.name: Big Head Mode
modifiers.text: Every bro’s head is twice the size, and so is the target.

modifiers.name: Pocket Bros
modifiers.text: Everyone is pocket-sized, hits softer and flies much further.

modifiers.name: Protein Shake Night
modifiers.text: Everyone is huge, heavy and hits harder.

modifiers.name: Fast Forward
modifiers.text: The whole show runs at 1.5× speed.

modifiers.name: Glass Jaws
modifiers.text: Everyone takes triple damage from everything.

modifiers.name: Launch Party
modifiers.text: Double knockback. Every hit is a rocket ride.

modifiers.name: One and Done
modifiers.text: One stock each, you and every foe. One fall ends the run.

modifiers.name: Item Monsoon
modifiers.text: Items pour from the sky, nonstop.

modifiers.name: Mirror, Mirror
modifiers.text: Every contestant is a copy of you. The host refuses.

modifiers.name: Identity Crisis
modifiers.text: You play a different random bro every round.

modifiers.name: Bro-pocalypse
modifiers.text: Every CPU fights at the hardest level, 9, from round 1.

modifiers.name: Second Wind
modifiers.text: Every KO you score heals you back to 0%.

modifiers.name: Shields Down
modifiers.text: Nobody can shield. Rolls and dodges still work.

modifiers.name: Shrinking Studio
modifiers.text: The blast zones close in as each round goes on.

modifiers.name: The Floor Is Lava
modifiers.text: Lava rises over the stage every 22 seconds.
